scenes.text: Let's build your first Node.js API from an empty folder, one layer at a time.
First, install Node.js. It runs JavaScript outside the browser. Check it with node dash dash version.
Next, start a project. npm init creates package.json, which tracks your dependencies and scripts.
Now add Express, a minimal web framework that routes HTTP requests in Node.
Write the server: define a route, then call app dot listen to accept requests on a port.
Finally, run it with node index dot js and open localhost three thousand in your browser.
Runtime, project, framework, server, run. Five layers, and you have a working API.
